settings.title: 🚚 Farm-Fresh Delivery
settings.content: Free shipping on orders above ₹499 across India. All organic staples are freshly ground and packed within 24 hours of dispatch.

settings.title: 1. Processing & Dispatch Timelines
settings.content:
All orders are freshly packed and dispatched from our Gujarat/Surat warehouse within 24 to 48 hours of order confirmation.

Orders placed on Sundays or national holidays are dispatched on the next working business day.

settings.title: 2. Estimated Delivery Timeframes
settings.content:
• Metro Cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai): 2–4 Business Days
  • Tier 2 & 3 Cities (Gujarat, Maharashtra, MP, Rajasthan): 3–5 Business Days
  • Rest of India & Remote Locations: 5–7 Business Days

settings.title: 3. Shipping Charges & COD
settings.content:
We offer free standard shipping on orders above ₹499. For orders below ₹499, a nominal flat shipping fee of ₹49 is charged.

Cash on Delivery (COD) is available for eligible pincodes across India with a flat ₹30 COD handling fee.

settings.title: 4. Order Tracking
settings.content: As soon as your parcel is handed over to our courier partner (BlueDart, Delhivery, DTDC), you will receive a tracking link via SMS, WhatsApp, and Email to monitor your parcel in real-time.
